advisories.title: The dated-recital path inventory is incomplete
advisories.finding: V5 creates a controlling liveStanding block and broadly says inherited v3/D-086 recitals are dated, but inheritedRecitals.fields does not enumerate every copied field that conflicts with current D-102 standing. Omitted examples include sliceScope.presentlyRecordableRequiredNames/countCheck, whatNamingIsNot, runnerClassFromD006, G03/G04 machinePinStanding and doesNotClaim, the G03/G04 owner-batch notes, remainingUnmetNamed's old MF-6 sentence, whatThisDoesNotDo's reserved-name recital, and commissionNote. The list also names an 'authorityClaim of v3' that is not the actual v5 authorityClaim field.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: The broader basedOn.relation says inherited v3/D-086 recitals are dated rather than live; inheritedRecitals.standing says they are not current measurements and liveStanding governs disagreement; liveStanding itself reproduces the current file-08 digest, 18-of-18 MET snapshot, D-102 G03/G04 status, and an explicit refusal to reopen D-102 or unname those gates. Those controlling clauses make the intended normative result unambiguous, and v5 binds nothing. The incomplete inventory is audit precision, not an operative regression.
advisories.suggestion: In the next successor, either enumerate every dated path precisely, use an explicit wildcard such as 'all fields inherited unchanged from v3 except G20/G21 and the standing split', or physically nest the historical snapshot under one historicalBasis object.

advisories.title: The legacy predecessor fields still skip the immediate version
advisories.finding: predecessor and predecessorSha256 still name v2 even though v5's immediate artifact predecessor is v4. The newer basedOn block correctly path- and digest-pins v4 and summarizes both v4 rejection sets, so the operative lineage resolves, but the older fields remain misleading. The v4 advisories are also not named in findingDisposition.
advisories.whyNotShouldFix: basedOn unambiguously identifies v4 at aa2bec2e, recordedInputs pins v3, and findingDisposition covers every v4 SHOULD-FIX item that gates acceptance. Neither the stale legacy label nor omission of advisory IDs changes the NT mapping, current standing, custody, or authority boundary.
advisories.suggestion: Point predecessor to v4 (or rename the v2 fields as historical review ancestry) and optionally add disposition rows for CLAUDE-GHN-V4-ADV1 and GHN-V4-A1.

The scoped NT routing remains correct: NT-1/NT-2/NT-6 ride G21, NT-4/NT-7 ride G20, NT-3/NT-5 remain leftover-design, G10 receives no NT class, requiredNow stays 18, and no DR-G row is added. The candidate binds nothing, marks no row SATISFIED, does not close leftover-design or make D-056 gates 2/3 hold, and authorizes no implementation. Advisories request a complete historical-path inventory and clearer predecessor metadata.
